clarity.notes: Sessions now uses the same WindowFrame as every other dock app — no special rail metaphor to learn. Dock stays centered; open/minimize/close match Dashboard.

hierarchy.notes: Opaque production-canvas windows read as the app; glass stays on shell furniture. Sessions list anatomy (recent → Show all → agent groups) unchanged inside the frame.

typography.notes: Verbatim production stack: Inter with cv01/ss03, 13.5px base; JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for session times and counts.

motion.notes: Removed the dock flex-grow slide (the failed flourish). Remaining motion is dock magnification + window open/genie minimize; reduce-motion honored.

brand.notes: Token block unchanged; Sessions body uses canvas + production list density, not a parallel glass rail surface.
